name: Kamimura Megumi
source:
Class: 2-B

[url=/c19333]Taichi's[/url] classmate, [url=/c19343]Madoka's[/url] best friend and a very neat and refined girl. She belongs to the same "Fraternity" group as [url=/c19347]Yuka[/url] and Mio. Yet, she doesn't seem to be completely enthralled by the group and is willing to give Taichi a hand, albeit reluctantly.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=804105]Getchu[/url]]
